text: On the left side of Seabrook Town's defensive half, about 10 metres from their own goal, Tariq Marlowe wins a strong tackle to regain possession. Almost instantly, he drives forward and shoots from just over 10 metres out, striking the ball with his foot towards Harbour City's goal at the far end. The shot finds the net, reducing Harbour City's lead to 2-1. This quick counter-attack comes immediately after the turnover, showing Seabrook Town's pressing intensity and swift transition play[#1103] [#1104].
